name: popsicle
headline: TuxSEO - Automated Blog Content Creation
short_description: TuxSEO automates blog content creation for founders who hate writing. It generates SEO-optimized blog posts, saving time and effort. Connects to Django-based CMS platforms and integrates with Claude agents for content generation.
author: rasulkireev

sections.overview:
TuxSEO is an open-source tool that automates blog content creation for founders and business owners. It learns about your business, analyzes market trends, and generates SEO-optimized blog posts to drive organic search traffic—eliminating time spent on research and writing. The platform is self-hostable and can run privately on your computer or via cloud deployment on Render, Docker, or CapRover. TuxSEO integrates with AI APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Perplexity) and tools like Tavily for market research to produce data-driven content ideas. It connects to Django-based CMS platforms and works with AI agents for streamlined content generation workflows.
Generate SEO-optimized blog posts without writing them yourself
Conduct market research and competitor analysis for content strategy
Create content calendars with keyword-driven topic ideas
Self-host a private content generation system on your infrastructure
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/rasulkireev/TuxSEO`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a 1,200-1,500 word SEO-optimized blog post for [TOPIC] targeting [TARGET_KEYWORD]. The post should be structured for readability with H2/H3 headings, include [NUMBER] internal links to existing blog content, and [NUMBER] external links to authoritative sources. Use a conversational tone suitable for [AUDIENCE]. Include a meta description (150-160 characters) and suggest 3-5 related long-tail keywords. Format the output as valid Markdown with proper spacing between sections. Publish-ready for a Django-based CMS like Wagtail or Django CMS.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
